lines.text: Nobody says how much money Ali and Bea have!
lines.caption: Nobody says how much money Ali and Bea have!

lines.text: Can two swaps still find the total?
lines.caption: Can two swaps still find the total?

lines.text: If Ali gives Bea twenty percent, they're equal.
lines.caption: If Ali gives Bea twenty percent, they're equal.

lines.text: If Bea gives Ali ten dollars instead, Ali has twice as much.
lines.caption: If Bea gives Ali ten dollars instead, Ali has twice as much.

lines.text: Twenty percent is one fifth. So split Ali's money into five parts.
lines.caption: Twenty percent is one fifth. So split Ali's money into five parts.

lines.text: He gives one part, and they're equal. So Bea started with three parts.
lines.caption: He gives one part, and they're equal. So Bea started with three parts.

lines.text: Ali has five parts, Bea has three. Eight in all!
lines.caption: Ali has five parts, Bea has three. Eight in all!

lines.text: The ten dollar swap makes one part thirty dollars. So, two hundred forty dollars together!
lines.caption: The ten dollar swap makes one part thirty dollars. So, two hundred forty dollars together!

lines.text: Ali has one hundred fifty, and Bea has ninety.
lines.caption: Ali has one hundred fifty, and Bea has ninety.
